artifact.note: What `check --artifact` proves about a built .app. Every component's runtime_resources must be present (by SHA-256), the required first-party files must be present, and no file with a registered extension (scripts, WebAssembly, fonts and tree-sitter query files) may ship unless its digest is a known runtime resource or first-party file. Compiled code (Swift packages, C parsers) cannot be matched by digest; it is covered by the source-tree check and the SBOM.
